cases.counterfactual_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((os (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
         (a (count-if (lambda (o)
              (>= (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))) (obj-cells o)) 3)) os))
         (b (- (length os) a))
         (pre-a (min a 4)) (pre-b (min b 4))
         (matched (min pre-a pre-b))
         (left-a (- pre-a matched)) (left-b (- pre-b matched))
         (green (take (list (list 0 0) (list 2 0) (list 0 2) (list 2 2)) (min left-b 4)))
         (blue (take (list (list 0 3) (list 2 3) (list 0 5) (list 2 5)) (min left-a 4))))
    (grid-from-fn 3 6 (lambda (r c)
      (cond ((member (list r c) green) 3)
            ((member (list r c) blue) 1)
            (else 0)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((visited (make-hash))
                  (type-a 0)
                  (type-b 0))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when
                     (and (= (at g r c) 2) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                     (let bfs
                          ((queue (list (list r c))) (cells (list)))
                          (cond
                            ((null? queue) (let* ((rmin (min-of first cells))
                                     (rmax (max-of first cells))
                                     (top-count (count-if (lambda (p)
                                                            (= (first p) rmin))
                                                          cells))
                                     (bot-count (count-if (lambda (p)
                                                            (= (first p) rmax))
                                                          cells)))
                                (if (>= top-count 3)
                                    (set! type-a (+ type-a 1))
                                    (set! type-b (+ type-b 1)))))
                            (else (let ((cr (first (car queue)))
                                        (cc (second (car queue))))
                                    (if (or
                                          (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc))
                                          (< cr 0)
                                          (>= cr h)
                                          (< cc 0)
                                          (>= cc w)
                                          (!= (at g cr cc) 2))
                                        (bfs (cdr queue) cells)
                                        (begin
                                          (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                                          (bfs (append (cdr queue)
                                                       (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                             (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                             (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                             (list cr (+ cc 1))))
                                               (cons (list cr cc) cells))))))))))
             (let ((green-pos (list (list 0 0) (list 2 0) (list 0 2) (list 2 2)))
                   (blue-pos (list (list 0 3) (list 2 3) (list 0 5) (list 2 5)))
                   (result (make-hash)))
               (for* ((r (range 0 3)) (c (range 0 6))) (hash-set! result (list r c) 0))
               (for ((i (range 0 (min type-b 4))))
                 (let ((pos (list-ref green-pos i))) (hash-set! result pos 3)))
               (for ((i (range 0 (min type-a 4))))
                 (let ((pos (list-ref blue-pos i))) (hash-set! result pos 1)))
               (build-grid 3 6 (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0)))))))

intermediate: The input-dependent top/bottom component census, matched-pair count min(top,bottom), and the two uncapped unmatched-object counts after cancellation.
step_a: Find the isolated red four-connected T components, classify their orientation, and cancel one top-bar T against one bottom-bar T until one orientation has no unmatched objects.
step_b: Cap each unmatched-object count at four and use the capped counts to select the fixed blue and green tally positions in the 3x6 emblem.
why_b_depends_on_a: The tally cannot be chosen from the original counts or their capped values: cancellation changes the counts that B must encode, and capping too early loses information about their difference. One witness reverses cancellation and capping; another skips cancellation on a dense30x30 scene. This is a count-state dependency, not a claim of spatial matching or iterative grid motion.
